<solution_file path="outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv">
import pandas as pd

# Read input data
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv')

# Pivot to wide format - one row per city_id, city_name, year
# Each indicator_id becomes a separate column
matrix = df.pivot(index=['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'], columns='indicator_id', values='value')

# Reset index to make identifier columns regular columns
matrix = matrix.reset_index()

# Fill missing values with empty string for proper CSV formatting
matrix = matrix.fillna('')

# Write to CSV with RFC 4180 compliance (pandas handles quoting automatically)
matrix.to_csv('outputs/t11_city_identifier_matrix.csv', index=False)
